instruction.text: Write a Blockly program for: 🕹️ Raspberry Pi Pico Retro OLED Arcade Console.

target.explanation: Verified Blockly XML workspace program for '🕹️ Raspberry Pi Pico Retro OLED Arcade Console' targeting rpi-pico. Configures initialization in the setup routine and periodic control logic in the continuous execution loop.
target.code:
<xml xmlns="https://developers.google.com/blockly/xml">
  <block type="arduino_program" x="40" y="40">
    <statement name="SETUP">
      <block type="serial_begin"><field name="BAUD">115200</field><next>
      <block type="io_pinmode"><field name="PIN">14</field><field name="MODE">INPUT</field><next>
      <block type="io_pinmode"><field name="PIN">15</field><field name="MODE">OUTPUT</field><next>
      <block type="io_pinmode"><field name="PIN">16</field><field name="MODE">OUTPUT</field><next>
      <block type="oled_print"><value name="TEXT"><block type="text_string"><field name="TEXT">🎮 PICO ARCADE</field></block></value></block>
      </next></block></next></block></next></block></next></block>
    </statement>
    <statement name="LOOP">
      <block type="controls_if">
        <mutation else="1"></mutation>
        <value name="IF0">
          <block type="io_digitalread"><field name="PIN">14</field></block>
        </value>
        <statement name="DO0">
          <block type="oled_print"><value name="TEXT"><block type="text_string"><field name="TEXT">>> LASER FIRED! <<</field></block></value><next>
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">16</field><field name="STATE">HIGH</field><next>
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">15</field><field name="STATE">HIGH</field><next>
          <block type="time_delay"><value name="MS"><shadow type="math_number"><field name="NUM">120</field></shadow></value><next>
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">15</field><field name="STATE">LOW</field><next>
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">16</field><field name="STATE">LOW</field>
          </block></next></block></next></block></next></block></next></block></next></block>
        </statement>
        <statement name="ELSE">
          <block type="oled_print"><value name="TEXT"><block type="text_string"><field name="TEXT">HI-SCORE: 9850</field></block></value><next>
          <block type="time_delay"><value name="MS"><shadow type="math_number"><field name="NUM">200</field></shadow></value>
          </block></next></block>
        </statement>
      </block>
    </statement>
  </block>
</xml>

<xml xmlns="https://developers.google.com/blockly/xml">
  <block type="arduino_program" x="40" y="40">
    <statement name="SETUP">
      <block type="serial_begin"><field name="BAUD">9600</field><next>
      <block type="io_pinmode"><field name="PIN">8</field><field name="MODE">OUTPUT</field><next>
      <block type="io_pinmode"><field name="PIN">12</field><field name="MODE">OUTPUT</field><next>
      <block type="io_pinmode"><field name="PIN">7</field><field name="MODE">OUTPUT</field><next>
      <block type="io_pinmode"><field name="PIN">6</field><field name="MODE">OUTPUT</field></block>
      </next></block></next></block></next></block></next></block>
    </statement>
    <statement name="LOOP">
      <block type="servo_write"><field name="PIN">9</field><value name="ANGLE"><shadow type="math_number"><field name="NUM">45</field></shadow></value><next>
      <block type="time_delay"><value name="MS"><shadow type="math_number"><field name="NUM">300</field></shadow></value><next>
      <block type="controls_if">
        <mutation else="1"></mutation>
        <value name="IF0">
          <block type="logic_compare"><field name="OP">LT</field>
            <value name="A"><block type="ultrasonic_read"><field name="TRIG">10</field><field name="ECHO">11</field></block></value>
            <value name="B"><block type="math_number"><field name="NUM">25</field></block></value>
          </block>
        </value>
        <statement name="DO0">
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">12</field><field name="STATE">HIGH</field><next>
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">7</field><field name="STATE">LOW</field><next>
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">6</field><field name="STATE">LOW</field><next>
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">8</field><field name="STATE">HIGH</field><next>
          <block type="time_delay"><value name="MS"><shadow type="math_number"><field name="NUM">150</field></shadow></value><next>
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">8</field><field name="STATE">LOW</field></block>
          </next></block></next></block></next></block></next></block></next></block>
        </statement>
        <statement name="ELSE">
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">12</field><field name="STATE">LOW</field><next>
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">7</field><field name="STATE">LOW</field><next>
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">6</field><field name="STATE">HIGH</field></block>
          </next></block></next></block>
        </statement>
        <next>
        <block type="servo_write"><field name="PIN">9</field><value name="ANGLE"><shadow type="math_number"><field name="NUM">135</field></shadow></value><next>
        <block type="time_delay"><value name="MS"><shadow type="math_number"><field name="NUM">400</field></shadow></value>
        </block></next></block>
        </next>
      </block>
      </next></block></next></block>
    </statement>
  </block>
</xml>

        <mutation else="1"></mutation>
        <value name="IF0"><block type="ai_is_detected"><field name="CLASS">person</field></block></value>

          <block type="servo_write"><field name="PIN">9</field><value name="ANGLE"><shadow type="math_number"><field name="NUM">90</field></shadow></value><next>
          <block type="tone_play"><field name="PIN">8</field><value name="FREQ"><shadow type="math_number"><field name="NUM">880</field></shadow></value><next>
          <block type="time_delay"><value name="MS"><shadow type="math_number"><field name="NUM">500</field></shadow></value></block>

        <statement name="ELSE">
          <block type="servo_write"><field name="PIN">9</field><value name="ANGLE"><shadow type="math_number"><field name="NUM">0</field></shadow></value><next>
          <block type="tone_stop"><field name="PIN">8</field></block>
          </next></block>
        </statement>
      </block>
    </statement>

</xml>

instruction.text: Build a ESP32 Mission 10 · Local HTTP Web Server & Phone Controller circuit using ESP32.

target.explanation: Launch an embedded HTTP Web Server on port 80 and switch Living Room and Bedroom LEDs from your Smartphone!
target.code:
<xml xmlns="https://developers.google.com/blockly/xml">
  <block type="arduino_program" x="40" y="40">
    <statement name="SETUP">
      <block type="wifi_connect">
        <value name="SSID"><block type="text_string"><field name="TEXT">SmartHome-WiFi</field></block></value>
        <value name="PASS"><block type="text_string"><field name="TEXT">pixiu123</field></block></value>
        <next>
        <block type="wifi_server_begin">
          <field name="PORT">80</field>
          <next>
          <block type="wifi_server_on">
            <field name="PATH">/</field>
            <statement name="DO">
              <block type="wifi_server_send">
                <field name="STATUS">200</field>
                <field name="TYPE">text/html</field>
                <value name="CONTENT">
                  <block type="text_string"><field name="TEXT"><h1>🏠 Smart Home</h1><a href="/red/on">Turn ON Red</a><a href="/red/off">Turn OFF Red</a></field></block>
                </value>
              </block>
            </statement>
            <next>
            <block type="wifi_server_on">
              <field name="PATH">/red/on</field>
              <statement name="DO">
                <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">4</field><field name="STATE">HIGH</field><next>
                <block type="wifi_server_send">
                  <field name="STATUS">200</field>
                  <field name="TYPE">text/html</field>
                  <value name="CONTENT">
                    <block type="text_string"><field name="TEXT"><h2>🔴 Red ON</h2><a href="/">Back</a></field></block>
                  </value>
                </block>
                </next></block>
              </statement>
            </block>
            </next></block>
          </block>
          </next></block>
        </next></block>
    </statement>
    <statement name="LOOP">
      <block type="time_delay"><value name="MS"><shadow type="math_number"><field name="NUM">100</field></shadow></value></block>
    </statement>
  </block>
</xml>

instruction.text: Build a micro:bit Mission 10 · PIR Motion & Siren Security System circuit using micro:bit.

target.explanation: Engineer a comprehensive security alert station: detect human motion with a PIR sensor on P1, activate an audible alarm buzzer on P0, and flash an alert LED on P2.
target.code:
<xml xmlns="https://developers.google.com/blockly/xml">
  <block type="arduino_program" x="40" y="40">
    <statement name="SETUP">
      <block type="io_pinmode"><field name="PIN">1</field><field name="MODE">INPUT</field><next>
      <block type="io_pinmode"><field name="PIN">2</field><field name="MODE">OUTPUT</field></block>
      </next></block>
    </statement>
    <statement name="LOOP">
      <block type="controls_if">
        <mutation else="1"></mutation>
        <value name="IF0">
          <block type="io_digitalread"><field name="PIN">1</field></block>
        </value>
        <statement name="DO0">
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">2</field><field name="STATE">HIGH</field><next>
          <block type="tone_play"><field name="PIN">0</field><value name="FREQ"><shadow type="math_number"><field name="NUM">880</field></shadow></value><next>
          <block type="microbit_show_icon"><field name="ICON">ghost</field></block>
          </next></block></next></block>
        </statement>
        <statement name="ELSE">
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">2</field><field name="STATE">LOW</field><next>
          <block type="tone_stop"><field name="PIN">0</field><next>
          <block type="microbit_clear"></block>
          </next></block></next></block>
        </statement>
        <next>
          <block type="time_delay"><value name="MS"><shadow type="math_number"><field name="NUM">50</field></shadow></value></block>
        </next>
      </block>
    </statement>
  </block>
</xml>

      <block type="controls_if">
        <mutation else="1"></mutation>

        <statement name="ELSE">
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">0</field><field name="STATE">LOW</field></block>
        </statement>
        <next>
          <block type="time_delay"><value name="MS"><shadow type="math_number"><field name="NUM">100</field></shadow></value></block>
        </next>
      </block>
    </statement>
  </block>
</xml>

instruction.text: Build a Pico Mission 10 · Smart Agriculture & Relay Pump Automation circuit using Raspberry Pi Pico.

target.explanation: Monitor soil moisture on ADC1 (GP27) and automatically energize an electromechanical relay on GP13 when soil is dry.
target.code:
<xml xmlns="https://developers.google.com/blockly/xml">
  <block type="arduino_program" x="40" y="40">
    <statement name="SETUP">
      <block type="io_pinmode"><field name="PIN">13</field><field name="MODE">OUTPUT</field></block>
    </statement>
    <statement name="LOOP">
      <block type="controls_if">
        <mutation else="1"></mutation>
        <value name="IF0">
          <block type="logic_compare">
            <field name="OP">LT</field>
            <value name="A"><block type="soil_moisture_read"></block></value>
            <value name="B"><block type="math_number"><field name="NUM">400</field></block></value>
          </block>
        </value>
        <statement name="DO0">
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">13</field><field name="STATE">HIGH</field></block>
        </statement>
        <statement name="ELSE">
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">13</field><field name="STATE">LOW</field></block>
        </statement>
      </block>
    </statement>
  </block>
</xml>

The ESP32 connects to Virtual Wi-Fi (SSID: SmartHome-WiFi), establishes an HTTP server on port 80, and serves an interactive web dashboard. Receiving client requests on endpoints /red/on, /red/off, /blue/on, or /blue/off triggers digital GPIO pins D4 and D15 to switch physical Living Room and Bedroom LEDs in real-time, responding with synchronized HTML status badges.
target.code:
<xml xmlns="https://developers.google.com/blockly/xml">
  <block type="arduino_program" x="40" y="40">
    <statement name="SETUP">
      <block type="serial_begin"><field name="BAUD">115200</field><next>
      <block type="io_pinmode"><field name="PIN">4</field><field name="MODE">OUTPUT</field><next>
      <block type="io_pinmode"><field name="PIN">15</field><field name="MODE">OUTPUT</field><next>
      <block type="wifi_connect">
        <value name="SSID"><block type="text_string"><field name="TEXT">SmartHome-WiFi</field></block></value>
        <value name="PASS"><block type="text_string"><field name="TEXT">pixiu123</field></block></value>
        <next>
        <block type="wifi_server_begin">
          <field name="PORT">80</field>
          <next>
          <block type="wifi_server_on">
            <field name="PATH">/</field>
            <statement name="DO">
              <block type="wifi_server_send">
                <field name="STATUS">200</field>
                <field name="TYPE">text/html</field>
                <value name="CONTENT">
                  <block type="text_string"><field name="TEXT"><h1>🏠 ESP32 Smart Home</h1><p>Tap to control room lights:</p><div><a href="/red/on">Turn ON Living Room</a><a href="/red/off">Turn OFF Living Room</a></div><div style="margin-top:10px;"><a href="/blue/on">Turn ON Bedroom</a><a href="/blue/off">Turn OFF Bedroom</a></div></field></block>
                </value>
              </block>
            </statement>
            <next>
            <block type="wifi_server_on">
              <field name="PATH">/red/on</field>
              <statement name="DO">
                <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">4</field><field name="STATE">HIGH</field><next>
                <block type="wifi_server_send">
                  <field name="STATUS">200</field>
                  <field name="TYPE">text/html</field>
                  <value name="CONTENT">
                    <block type="text_string"><field name="TEXT"><h2 style="color:#ef4444">🔴 Living Room Light: ON</h2><a href="/">← Back to Dashboard</a></field></block>
                  </value>
                </block>
                </next></block>
              </statement>
              <next>
              <block type="wifi_server_on">
                <field name="PATH">/red/off</field>
                <statement name="DO">
                  <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">4</field><field name="STATE">LOW</field><next>
                  <block type="wifi_server_send">
                    <field name="STATUS">200</field>
                    <field name="TYPE">text/html</field>
                    <value name="CONTENT">
                      <block type="text_string"><field name="TEXT"><h2>⚪ Living Room Light: OFF</h2><a href="/">← Back to Dashboard</a></field></block>
                    </value>
                  </block>
                  </next></block>
                </statement>
                <next>
                <block type="wifi_server_on">
                  <field name="PATH">/blue/on</field>
                  <statement name="DO">
                    <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">15</field><field name="STATE">HIGH</field><next>
                    <block type="wifi_server_send">
                      <field name="STATUS">200</field>
                      <field name="TYPE">text/html</field>
                      <value name="CONTENT">
                        <block type="text_string"><field name="TEXT"><h2 style="color:#38bdf8">🔵 Bedroom Light: ON</h2><a href="/">← Back to Dashboard</a></field></block>
                      </value>
                    </block>
                    </next></block>
                  </statement>
                  <next>
                  <block type="wifi_server_on">
                    <field name="PATH">/blue/off</field>
                    <statement name="DO">
                      <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">15</field><field name="STATE">LOW</field><next>
                      <block type="wifi_server_send">
                        <field name="STATUS">200</field>
                        <field name="TYPE">text/html</field>
                        <value name="CONTENT">
                          <block type="text_string"><field name="TEXT"><h2>⚪ Bedroom Light: OFF</h2><a href="/">← Back to Dashboard</a></field></block>
                        </value>
                      </block>
                      </next></block>
                    </statement>
                  </block>
                  </next></block>
                </next></block>
              </next></block>
            </next></block>
          </block>
          </next></block>
        </next></block>
      </next></block></next></block></next></block>
    </statement>
    <statement name="LOOP">
      <block type="time_delay"><value name="MS"><shadow type="math_number"><field name="NUM">100</field></shadow></value></block>
    </statement>
  </block>
</xml>

instruction.text: Build a 💡 Smart Night Lamp & Perimeter Security circuit using Arduino Uno.

target.explanation: Photosensitive ambient light controller and motion security system! A Light Dependent Resistor (LDR) monitors ambient illumination on analog pin A0. instruction.text: Build a 🎛️ Rotary Encoder Digital Cockpit Dial circuit using Arduino Uno.

instruction.text: Build a 🏠 Automated Smart Home circuit using Arduino Uno.

target.explanation: High-voltage home automation with PIR motion and electromechanical relay! The PIR motion sensor monitors room occupancy on digital pin D7. When movement is detected, Arduino energizes an electromechanical relay module on pin D8. The relay's internal electromagnet closes the Normally Open (NO) contacts, routing power from a 9V battery to spin a ceiling cooling fan (DC motor) at 1800 RPM and illuminate the room lamp.

target.explanation: Retro handheld gaming console built on the RP2040 Raspberry Pi Pico! The system initializes a 128×64 SSD1306 OLED over I2C (GP4 SDA / GP5 SCL) displaying game scores. <xml xmlns="https://developers.google.com/blockly/xml">
  <block type="arduino_program" x="40" y="40">
    <statement name="SETUP">
      <block type="serial_begin"><field name="BAUD">115200</field><next>
      <block type="io_pinmode"><field name="PIN">14</field><field name="MODE">INPUT</field><next>
      <block type="io_pinmode"><field name="PIN">15</field><field name="MODE">OUTPUT</field><next>
      <block type="io_pinmode"><field name="PIN">16</field><field name="MODE">OUTPUT</field><next>
      <block type="oled_print"><value name="TEXT"><block type="text_string"><field name="TEXT">🎮 PICO ARCADE</field></block></value></block>
      </next></block></next></block></next></block></next></block>
    </statement>
    <statement name="LOOP">
      <block type="controls_if">
        <mutation else="1"></mutation>
        <value name="IF0">
          <block type="io_digitalread"><field name="PIN">14</field></block>
        </value>
        <statement name="DO0">
          <block type="oled_print"><value name="TEXT"><block type="text_string"><field name="TEXT">>> LASER FIRED! <<</field></block></value><next>

          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">15</field><field name="STATE">HIGH</field><next>
          <block type="time_delay"><value name="MS"><shadow type="math_number"><field name="NUM">120</field></shadow></value><next>
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">15</field><field name="STATE">LOW</field><next>
          <block type="io_digitalwrite"><field name="PIN">16</field><field name="STATE">LOW</field>
          </block></next></block></next></block></next></block></next></block></next></block>
        </statement>
        <statement name="ELSE">
